simple.summary: שׁוֹעַ (Shôwaʻ) means Shoa , an Oriental people First listed occurrence: Ezek 23 23.

definitions.full: H7772. Shoa III. שׁוֺעַ proper name, of a people Ezek 23:23 usually identified with Assyrian Sutû, Sutî, nomads of Mesop. and (later) east of Tigris, Dl Pa 234 ff. COT on the passage Wkl KAT 3. 22 Dt Hast. DB KOA .
